# Data Dictionary — MLG/ULB *Credit Card Fraud Detection*

**Project:** Projeto Integrador do Grupo 54 — Centro Universitário SENAC
**Base:** Credit Card Fraud Detection Dataset (Worldline e Machine Learning Group — Université Libre de Bruxelles)
**Raw file:** `data/raw/creditcard.csv` (not versioned)
**Prepared file:** `data/processed/transactions.parquet` (not versioned, generated by the pipeline)

## 1. Provenance

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Official source | Kaggle — https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud |
| Authors | Andrea Dal Pozzolo, Olivier Caelen, Reid A. Johnson, Gianluca Bontempi |
| Access date recorded in the plan | 17/11/2026 |
| Generation date of this prepared base | 18/11/2026 |
| File | `creditcard.csv` (150,828,752 bytes) |
| MD5 of the raw file | `e90efcb83d69faf99fcab8b0255024de` |
| License stated on the base page | Open Database License (ODbL) — confirm on the official page before delivery |
| Personal data | No direct identifiers; attributes are anonymized by PCA |

The raw file is immutable and protected by `.gitignore`. Every transformation
generates a copy in `data/processed/`, never an edit of the original.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Records | 284,807 |
| Columns | 31 |
| Missing values | 0 |
| Exact duplicates | 1,081 |
| Fraudulent transactions | 492 (0.1727%) |
| Legitimate transactions | 284,315 |

| `Amount` total | 25,162,590.01 (original unit; currency not fixed by the dictionary) |

## 3. Columns

| Column | Type | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Time` | float | Seconds since the first transaction in the base | Relative time; not absolute date/time |
| `V1`–`V28` | float | Principal components obtained by PCA | Business meaning not disclosed; do not name factors |
| `Amount` | float | Transaction value | Original base unit; currency not fixed by the dictionary |
| `Class` | int | Label: 1 = fraud, 0 = legitimate | Target variable |

**Derived columns (not stored in the prepared base):**

| Derived column | Origin | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `elapsed_hour` | `Time` | `floor(Time / 3600)` |
| `relative_day` | `Time` | `floor(Time / 86400) + 1` (days 1 and 2) |
| `relative_day_hour` | `Time` | Hour within the relative 24-hour block; **not** wall-clock hour |
| `value_band` | `Amount` | Bands `0-10`, `10-50`, `50-100`, `100-250`, `250-500`, `500-1,000`, `1,000+` (left-closed interval) |

## 4. Treatment applied

- Exact duplicates: removed (first occurrence kept). Impact: 1,081 rows and
  19 frauds fewer; the prepared base becomes **283,726 rows and 473
  frauds (0.17%)**. The decision is recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md` (D-11).
- Zero `Amount` values: kept; not invalid in the base.
- `Amount` outliers: kept; frauds may be at the extremes.
- Nulls: none in the file; the pipeline maintains schema validation.
- No column was renamed, dropped, or rescaled in the prepared base.

## 5. Mandatory reading limitations

- The base covers **two days** of European card transactions in September 2013.
- `Time` is relative; no absolute date or confirmed wall-clock hour.
- `V1`–`V28` are PCA-anonymized: business factors cannot be named.
- Currency is not defined in the dictionary; the dashboard uses the **original
  unit**, with no conversion and no `R$` symbol.
- No card identifier, merchant, category, device, or transaction type exists.
  The sketch's "transaction type" filter is not feasible on this base.
- Few positives (473 after cleaning) make metrics sensitive to the split.

## 6. Reproducibility

```bash
uv run credit-card-fraud-pipeline prepare    # audits, cleans, and writes Parquet
uv run credit-card-fraud-pipeline eda        # figures and EDA report
uv run credit-card-fraud-pipeline train      # model, metrics, and report
```

Outputs:

| Artifact | Path |
|---|---|
| Prepared base | `data/processed/transactions.parquet` |
| Audit and cleaning | `reports/RELATORIO_QUALIDADE.md`, `reports/quality.json` |
| EDA | `reports/RELATORIO_EDA.md`, `reports/figures/eda_*.png` |
| Model and metrics | `reports/model/model_final.joblib`, `reports/model/metrics.json` |
| Evaluation | `reports/RELATORIO_MODELO.md`, `reports/figures/modelo_*.png` |

Seed: `SEED = 42` (`src/credit_card_fraud/config.py`).
